# Loop If

Source: [4390](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4390); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Loop If](../../api/actions/loop-if.md).

<a id="wiki-4390-n1"></a>

- Loop If tests its own predicate, restarts the whole action list when true, and requires an executed Wait since the list began.
